comment: Mc-incremental EMC values (#41, #47, #55). GENERATED by docs/research/emc-pricing/generate.py from hand_values.json, rarity.json and ore_yields.json there: do not edit by hand, edit those and re-run it. ProjectE applies this file after its datapack defaults, so these values win. It holds only what neither ProjectE nor the Prestige mod's GT recipe mapper (#52) can derive: hand values (steam-age parts, vanilla items GT hides from ProjectE, obtainable items no recipe makes), every ore block and raw ore (worth what fully processing it yields), the dusts of materials only ever met as byproducts (priced by rarity), items whose only recipes ProjectE can't map (crafting with a GT tool, decompositions; pinned at that recipe's ingredient cost) and filled buckets (empty bucket + fluid). The Transmutation Tablet is 0: the Prestige mod hands it out. See docs/pocs/poc-1.md.
